## `get_default_value`

*Available in [R](#get_default_value-r)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function returns a specific user level defaults set in ~/cida_defaults.dcf

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    get_default_value(parameter)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `parameter` - The name of the specific parameter to lookup.

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    The user level defaults named parameter
